title: Report page goes blank (React error #31) when a report's label or description is the spec's inline locale map (I18nLabel { zh-CN, en })
body:
Category: ① defect with reach — every app that gives a report an inline-locale `label`/`description` (the only way to translate a report: the translation bundle has no `reports` group) gets a blank report page for every viewer.

Who acts: objectui maintainer seat (app-shell `ReportView`).

Dedupe: searched objectui + objectstack for "report label locale map React error 31 / I18nLabel report crash" — 0 hits on reports; 22 hits in the same family (closed: objectui#13380 public form, objectui#11158 Studio nav rail, objectui#10847 dashboard designer widget title, objectui#10993 form submitText). `ReportView` was not covered by any of them.

## Repro

- `@objectstack/spec` / runtime 18.0.0, console from the same release.
- Report metadata (valid under `ReportSchema`, whose `label` is `string | I18nLabel`):

```ts
defineReport({
  name: 'srm_delivery_scorecard',
  label: { 'zh-CN': '供应商交付与质量（按期间）', en: 'Supplier Delivery and Quality by Period' },
  description: { 'zh-CN': '…', en: '…' },
  type: 'summary',
  dataset: 'srm_delivery_metrics',
  rows: ['period', 'supplier'],
  values: ['line_count', 'otd_rate'],
})
```

- Open `/_console/apps/<app>/report/srm_delivery_scorecard` as any user.

## Actual

Whole page is blank; console: `Minified React error #31 … object with keys {zh-CN, en}`.

## Expected

The label and description resolve to the viewer's locale, like object/field labels do.

## Where

`packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx` renders `{previewReport.title || previewReport.label || 'Report Viewer'}` and `{previewReport.description}` raw (still so on main). The report lists (`全部报表`, nav) may need the same resolution.

## Downstream

objectstack-ai/hotsrm works around it by using a plain Chinese label (English lost for this report) until this is fixed.

Filed from Claude session session_01E7UNrUkwEKDrg7BXnKF5LU (hotsrm v0.4 browser acceptance).
